<!-- pr-reviewer: 3c65e18a2732ead7d61bec553d622a4d59c51f9e -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`: merges at the next cut).

**What looks good**
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in `crates/geometry/src/sketch_chains/` (grep clean). Indexing goes through `get`; the only casts are `work as u64` and `k as i64` on a bounded arc loop (`nesting.rs`, `for _ in 0..8`).
- Input is validated up front in `curve.rs` (`in_range`: non-finite, |v| >= 1e7 mm, invalid arc/circle) and the tolerance is range-checked in `chain()`. Everything else is a named per-chain refusal, never a silent repair.
- Time is bounded: `Budget` (200M pair tests, 2M primitives) is spent in `connect::clusters`, `crossing::search` and `nesting::containers`; overrun gives `TooComplex`. The `retain` passes are bounded by the active list, which is itself budgeted on the next line.
- Nesting is an exact crossing-number test on the arcs (y-monotone cuts at top and bottom points, half-open edge rule), not on chords; contact between loops (touching or crossing) gets `NestingAmbiguous` instead of a role, so near-tangent cases are refused by name rather than guessed.
- The seeded fuzz does compare against `geo2d::Region`: `sketch_chains_nesting.rs:41-47` (200 nests) and `sketch_chains_refusals.rs:299-302` (400 grid sketches, accepted loops pass `Region::new`).
- Provenance lines on every submodule cite published sources (Bentley/Stanat/Williams, Tarjan, FNV-1a, Cohen et al., O'Rourke, Schneider/Eberly, Shimrat, Haines, Green). No vendor material.
- Files: largest source `curve.rs` 300 lines, largest test 356; all under ~400. No Cargo.toml change, so no new dependency; `docs/decisions/1861-sketch-chaining.md` is present. Tests sit in `crates/geometry/tests/` with the code they test.
- No process files changed (no `PROCESS_VERSION` bump needed); no snapshot PNGs, no goldens touched.

**Results merged with main** (locally on m5, trial merge with upstream/main, clean; not run on the runner)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry --no-run` | builds |
| `--test sketch_chains` | 7 passed |
| `--test sketch_chains_nesting` | 4 passed |
| `--test sketch_chains_refusals` | 7 passed (7.1 s debug) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Open chains are not checked for self-crossing, and a tangent-cusp meeting can read as `SelfCrossing` (both already stated in the PR body). Worth a follow-up issue before #1862 relies on open chains for contour paths.
- Nothing calls `chain()` yet (#1862); no MCP tool is owed by this PR.
- Debug-build timing only; the release lanes were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
